style: cel-shaded toon game art, thick dark outlines, theatrical stage lighting, deep violet velvet, glowing faceted jewels, saturated neon rim light
notes: One art style for the whole project, repeated word for word at the head of every prompt (rule F.1c). Every sprite that takes part in the mechanic declares its orientation in words (rule C.8); the symmetric ones say so explicitly so nothing is mirrored by accident. No prompt argues about the background colour - the pipeline cuts the background away (rule F.1b). The six 9-sliced sprites (pedestal, hold ribbon, meter fill, curtain arch, stage haze, panel plate) ask for a uniform border and a flat stretchable middle, because their .meta gives them a real spriteBorder. There is no audio asset of any kind (rule C.20), no prompt contains the app name and no sprite carries lettering (hard rule 1) - the emblem is an abstract mark. The icon hero is the pearl star jewel.
